description: Price a domain operation before any approval. Use when the user wants the exact price to buy, transfer, renew or restore a domain. Before: check_domain (needs domain lookup access) for a new name. Returns a job; its result (get_job, needs job read access) holds the quote id. Scope: domain:quote. Cost: free. Always quote before asking a person to buy.

idempotency_key.description: Unique per request. Reuse it on retry.

operation.description: What to price: create (buy), transfer, renew or restore.
